method: Headlines collected via web search (fetch_news.py collector blocked in sandbox; use it for local/Actions runs). Entity sentiment scored by Claude during the weekly Cowork routine. sentiment = 0-100 D-favorability of coverage tone (matches existing dashboard sentimentScore semantics: >55 leans D, <45 leans R). candidateSentiment = 0-100 favorability of coverage toward that candidate personally. outletLean: -2 left ... +2 right (AllSides-style); null = unrated outlet, excluded from scatter.

races.matchup: Susan Collins (R, inc.) vs. Troy Jackson (D)
races.summary: Maine Democrats formally nominated Troy Jackson on Jul 25, 566 of 571 delegates, closing the Platner episode. A UNH poll fielded Jul 15-20 put Jackson 49-46 over Collins, a statistical tie, and Jackson's campaign reported $2M in the first 48 hours after the nomination. Collins retains the cash advantage (~$11M on hand plus an allied super PAC) and coverage has turned to direct attacks between the two.

articles.headline: Troy Jackson has slight edge over Susan Collins, new poll finds
Democrats in Maine formally nominate Troy Jackson as their new U.S. Senate candidate
How Troy Jackson and Susan Collins are attacking one another in Maine's U.S. Senate race

races.matchup: Hannah Pingree (D) vs. Bobby Charles (R) vs. Rick Bennett (I)
races.summary: Pingree holds a wide lead: the Jul 1 BDN/Siena poll has her at 50% to Charles's 36% with Bennett at 8%. Coverage frames the general as Pingree's to lose, with Bennett's independent bid the main wildcard.

articles.headline: Hannah Pingree leads Bobby Charles in Maine governor's race poll
Maine gubernatorial candidates trade barbs on first day of general campaign
Bobby Charles secures Republican nomination for governor

races.matchup: Aug 4 D primary: Haley Stevens vs. Abdul El-Sayed; winner faces Mike Rogers (R)
races.summary: The Aug 4 Democratic primary is unresolved and expensive. A Detroit News/WDIV-Glengariff poll had Stevens up 48-41 while other surveys showed El-Sayed narrowly ahead. Pro-Stevens outside groups have spent north of $50M, including AIPAC-linked ads featuring Barack Obama, who has not endorsed. A late-July general-election poll found Stevens leading Rogers 47-45 but Rogers beating El-Sayed 49-39, which has made electability the closing argument.

articles.headline: Read full Detroit News/WDIV poll of Michigan Democratic primary voters
Barack Obama hasn't endorsed a Michigan Senate candidate. An AIPAC-linked group is spending millions on ads with him anyway
Contentious Democratic Senate contest dominates Michigan's primary season

races.matchup: Jocelyn Benson (D) vs. John James (R) — both favored in Aug 4 primaries
races.summary: Benson leads Sheriff Chris Swanson 72-12 in a Detroit News/WDIV-Glengariff primary poll and has outraised him roughly seven to one in 2026. Trump's endorsement of John James collapsed the Republican field: Aric Nesbitt and then Mike Cox exited, with Cox suspending Jul 17 while remaining on the ballot. Coverage treats the November matchup as effectively set.

articles.headline: Jocelyn Benson builds huge lead over Chris Swanson in new primary poll
State of the Race: Democrats line up behind Benson, Republicans face off in brutal two-way primary

races.matchup: Jon Husted (R, appt.) vs. Sherrod Brown (D)
races.summary: Still a genuine dead heat. A mid-June likely-voter poll gave Brown a narrow edge and the RCP average sits inside a point, while Husted retains Trump's endorsement and a fundraising machine. Analysts quoted across coverage agree no clear favorite has emerged; every public poll lands within the margin of error.

articles.headline: Sherrod Brown chances of ousting GOP's Jon Husted in Ohio Senate race — Polls
2026 Ohio Senate Special Election polls: Husted vs. Brown

races.summary: July polling gives Acton a slight edge as Ramaswamy's early lead keeps narrowing, driven by movement among women. But the structural coverage still favors him: unified GOP, Trump endorsement, and a $26.8M war chest (thanks to a $25M self-loan) against Acton's $11.5M raised. Outlets split on who's actually ahead.

articles.headline: Vivek Ramaswamy, Amy Acton nearly tied in Ohio gubernatorial race: Poll
2026 Ohio Governor polls: Ramaswamy vs. Acton

races.summary: The race is tightening: PPP (Jul 10-11) has Cooper +4, down from double digits, as GOP support coalesces behind Whatley. Cooper's $14.8M quarter and name-ID edge still anchor a pro-D coverage tilt, but 'Whatley gaining' is now the dominant frame.

articles.headline: Poll shows North Carolina Senate race tightening
Cooper raises $14.8 million in 3 months, new poll shows Whatley gaining ground
Cooper leads, but Whatley has a path

races.matchup: Jon Ossoff (D, inc.) vs. Mike Collins (R)
races.summary: An AARP poll by Fabrizio Ward and Impact Research fielded Jul 13-16 put Ossoff up 52-43, with a 30-point edge among younger voters offset by Collins leading by 24 among those 65 and older. Ossoff reported $20M raised in Q2 and roughly $42M on hand against Collins' $2.1M raised, about a 20-to-1 cash gap, and went on air with a seven-figure buy over Collins' vote against releasing the Epstein files.

articles.headline: Ossoff leads Collins by 9 points in Georgia Senate race: Poll
At the Races: Seeing blue in Georgia

races.matchup: Rick Jackson (R) vs. Keisha Lance Bottoms (D)
races.summary: Fox's July poll shows meaningful ticket-splitting: 11% of Ossoff voters back Jackson for governor. Bottoms is better-liked (52/38 favorable) than Jackson (43/38), keeping coverage slightly D-tilted in a Toss-up open seat.

articles.headline: Jon Ossoff leads Mike Collins by double digits in Georgia Senate poll
Georgia Senate race 2026: Trump and Ossoff exchange attacks after Collins wins GOP nomination

races.summary: Iowa's open-seat Senate race stays a pure coin flip in coverage: NYT/Siena has Hinson +2 while Fox News has Turek +4, both within error. Turek's paralympian-to-legislator story keeps earning favorable profiles; Hinson holds the R-lean fundamentals.

articles.headline: Polls: Iowa's U.S. Senate campaign tight, Sand leads for governor
Josh Turek holds 4-point lead over Ashley Hinson in Iowa Senate race

races.summary: Sand leads Lahn in both new polls (NYT/Siena 48-47; Fox News 53-44) with notable crossover support from Hinson voters. Coverage frames the open governorship as Democrats' best Iowa opportunity in a decade.

articles.headline: Polls: Iowa's U.S. Senate campaign tight, Sand leads for governor

races.matchup: Joe Lombardo (R, inc.) vs. Aaron Ford (D)
races.summary: A rough week for Lombardo: bodycam video showed him invoking his name to avoid a red-light citation, drawing an 'abuse of authority' attack from Ford, while Newsom headlined the Democrats' canvassing kickoff. Polling still gives Lombardo a slight edge, but the coverage tone moved toward Ford.

articles.headline: Gov. Joe Lombardo abused his authority during traffic stop, Aaron Ford says
Newsom stumps for Ford and Horsford
New poll shows Lombardo has slight lead in 2026 governor matchup

races.matchup: Aug 11 primaries — D: Hong, Barnes, Crowley, Roys, Brennan; R: Tom Tiffany (Trump-endorsed) front-runner
races.summary: Two July polls show state Rep. Francesca Hong, a DSA member, leading a scrambled Democratic primary: Marquette Law School had Hong 38, Barnes 16, Crowley 7 with most voters undecided, and a State Navigate survey had Hong 44, Crowley 15, Barnes 14. Marquette also found Barnes is the strongest Democrat against Tiffany, leading him 44-40, which is fuelling an electability fight in the final two weeks.

articles.headline: Hong leads latest Marquette poll, but most voters undecided in Democratic primary for governor
Who is running for Wisconsin governor? Check candidate list here
Hong holds strong double-digit lead in Wisconsin Democratic governor's primary: Poll

races.matchup: Katie Hobbs (D, inc.) vs. Andy Biggs (R)
races.summary: Biggs won the Jul 21 Republican primary decisively, taking roughly 70% to Rep. David Schweikert's 17% on Trump's endorsement and a large cash edge; Hobbs was unopposed. General-election polling since is close and inconsistent, with surveys in the window ranging from Hobbs 41-37 to a 44-43 Emerson result.

articles.headline: Andy Biggs wins Arizona GOP Governor primary. Election results 2026 live updates
Trump-backed Andy Biggs wins GOP nomination for governor and other Arizona primary takeaways

races.matchup: Chris Pappas (D) vs. Sep 8 R primary: John E. Sununu (Trump-endorsed) vs. Scott Brown
races.summary: Q2 filings showed Pappas raising $3.5M with about $5.1M on hand, against roughly $1.5M raised and $3M banked for Sununu and $279,000 raised for Brown. Trump's endorsement plus a UNH poll showing Sununu up 48-25 has made the Republican primary lopsided. Republicans spent the window using Maine Democrats' nominee swap as an attack line against Pappas.

articles.headline: Pappas, Sununu, Sullivan, and DiLorenzo boast campaign funding hauls
Democrats' primary shake-up becomes GOP ammunition in New Hampshire Senate race

races.matchup: Kelly Ayotte (R, inc.) vs. Cinde Warmington (D)
races.summary: Ayotte remains favored: first-term NH incumbents have lost only twice in a century, she won by 9+ in 2024, and UNH polling keeps her ahead. Coverage of her legislative record and Trump-proximity risk gives Warmington openings, but the race stays in the R-hold frame ahead of the Sep 8 primary.

articles.headline: Adversarial, aloof, agreeable: Ayotte's work with lawmakers at center of her reelection bid
Republican Kelly Ayotte and Democrat Cinde Warmington file for N.H. governor's race, trade barbs

races.matchup: Aug 4 open-seat primaries (Kelly term-limited) — R: Ty Masterson (Trump-endorsed) et al.; D: Ethan Corson (Kelly-endorsed), Cindy Holscher, Curt Skoog
races.summary: Ten candidates remain on the ballot, seven Republicans and three Democrats. Masterson is the presumed GOP front-runner on Trump's endorsement and a lopsided Sedgwick County straw-poll win, while Club for Growth-linked ads attack Vicki Schmidt and Masterson takes fire over data-center tax breaks. Kelly reaffirmed her endorsement of Corson in July. No credible public head-to-head primary polling surfaced.

articles.headline: Meet the 2026 Candidates for Kansas Governor
WATCH: 10 candidates vying for Kansas governor ahead of Aug. 4 primary
Who's running for Kansas governor in 2026? Here's a guide to the candidates

races.matchup: Kurt Alme (R) vs. Alani Bankhead (D) vs. Seth Bodnar (I)
races.summary: The four-way general field is set (Alme-R, Bankhead-D, Bodnar-I, Austin-L), and the anti-consolidation problem is now explicit: 17 Democratic legislators publicly urged Bankhead and Bodnar to unify. Coverage continues to frame the split opposition as securing the GOP hold.

articles.headline: Four general election candidates to compete for Montana's open U.S. Senate seat
Democratic legislators want a consolidated U.S. Senate race in Montana
Divided Montana Senate field helps Republicans

races.matchup: Dan Sullivan (R, inc.) vs. Mary Peltola (D) — Aug 18 top-four primary, RCV general
races.summary: Q2 filings dominated coverage: Peltola raised $6.9M from April through June, more than triple Sullivan's roughly $2M, with $6M from individuals. Heavy spending left her with $6.1M on hand against Sullivan's $8.3M. Fifteen candidates are on the primary ballot, including the second, unrelated Dan Sullivan the Alaska Supreme Court allowed to remain.

articles.headline: Election 2026: Sen. Sullivan raises less than half of Peltola's campaign in second quarter
Peltola vastly outraises Sullivan in Alaska's U.S. Senate race
Peltola raises millions more than Sullivan in Alaska's U.S. Senate race

races.matchup: Pete Ricketts (R, inc.) vs. Dan Osborn (I)
races.summary: A new statewide survey has the race in a statistical tie (Ricketts 48, Osborn 47), and Democratic nominee Cindy Burbank moved to withdraw on Jul 17 - pending an AG opinion - which would consolidate the anti-Ricketts vote behind Osborn. Coverage increasingly treats Nebraska as a genuine sleeper race.

articles.headline: NEW POLL: Dan Osborn is Tied With Pete Ricketts in Critical Nebraska Senate Race

races.summary: A Texas Public Opinion Research poll released Jul 28 gave Talarico a 45-40 lead, his largest of the general election and Paxton's lowest share since the runoff, driven by independents. Talarico raised $30M in Q2 to Paxton's $9M and ended June with $23.3M on hand, more than triple Paxton's. Cook already moved the race Likely R to Lean R in June.

articles.headline: Tracking the money raised and spent in the U.S. Senate race between James Talarico and Ken Paxton
Talarico leads Paxton by 5 points in new poll of Texas' U.S. Senate race
James Talarico expands lead over Ken Paxton in new Texas Senate poll

races.matchup: Greg Abbott (R, inc.) vs. Gina Hinojosa (D)
races.summary: Abbott stays favored — the RCP average has him +6.8 and stuck near 49 — but the narrowing storyline persists: Texas Public Opinion Research has it within 5, with Hinojosa winning independents, moderates, and Latino voters. A third of voters still don't know her, which reads as both ceiling and runway.

articles.headline: Democrat Gina Hinojosa launches first ad of Texas governor's race
2026 Texas Governor polls: Abbott vs. Hinojosa
